footer.promise: Orchester Cloud keeps your account and invites. Your projects never pass through it.

field.passwordRule: 12 to 256 characters. A long phrase is fine; there are no rules about symbols.

error.emailInvalid: Enter a full email address, like name@example.com.
error.passwordShort: Use at least 12 characters; this one has {{count}}.
error.passwordLong: Use at most 256 characters; this one has {{count}}.
error.displayNameLong: Use at most 100 characters; this one has {{count}}.
error.refused: Orchester Cloud did not accept this. Check the fields and try again.
error.unavailable: Orchester Cloud is not answering right now. Try again in a minute.
error.formExpired: This form has expired. Reload the page and try again.
error.tooManyEmails: Too many emails were sent. Try again in {{minutes}} min, at {{time}}.
error.tooManyTries: Too many tries from your network. Try again in {{minutes}} min, at {{time}}.

signup.title: Create your Orchester account
signup.description: One account for Orchester on all your computers. Team servers use it to know who you are and to send you invites; your projects never pass through it.
signup.displayNameHint: Teammates see this name on tasks and invites.
signup.small: We email you a link to confirm your address before you can sign in.
signup.question: Already have an account?

sent.title: Check your email
sent.description: We sent a confirmation link to
sent.next: Open it on any device to confirm your address; it works once, for 24 hours. Then sign in to Orchester with this email and your password.
sent.registered: If this email already has an account, the message says so and how to sign in instead.
sent.sentAgain: Sent again at {{time}}. It can take a minute to arrive.
sent.limit: Resend unavailable until {{time}}. We send at most 5 emails an hour to one address.
sent.question: Already confirmed?

confirm.title: Confirm your email
confirm.description: Confirm that this is your address for Orchester:
confirm.passwordHint: The password you chose when you created this account.
confirm.notYou: If you did not create an Orchester account, close this page. Without its password, nothing is confirmed.
confirm.confirmedDescription: Your Orchester account is ready. Sign in with this email:
confirm.confirmedNext: Sign in here to download Orchester and see your invites, or open the desktop app if you already have it.
confirm.expiredDescription: Confirmation links work once, for 24 hours. If you already confirmed your email, sign in. If not, we send you a new link.
confirm.failed: This link and password don't match. Check the password, or send a new link.
confirm.tooMany: Too many wrong passwords for this link. Try again in {{minutes}} min, at {{time}}, or send a new link.

signin.title: Sign in to Orchester
signin.description: Use the email and password of your Orchester account.
signin.wrong: The email or password is not right. Check both, or reset your password.
signin.unconfirmedBody: We sent a link to {{email}} when you signed up. Open it, then sign in again.
signin.tooMany: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} min, at {{time}}.
signin.question: New to Orchester?

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter the email of your Orchester account. We send you a link to choose a new password; it works once, for 1 hour.
forgot.question: Remembered it?
forgot.sentDescription: If this email has an Orchester account, we sent it a link to reset the password:
forgot.sentNext: The link works once, for 1 hour.
forgot.sentSmall: No email after a few minutes? Check your spam folder, and that this is the address you signed up with.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.note: Setting it signs your other computers and browsers out of your Orchester account. Their projects on team servers keep working.
reset.doneDescription: Your other computers and browsers were signed out of your Orchester account. Sign in there with the new password; their projects on team servers keep working meanwhile.
reset.expiredTitle: This reset link no longer works
reset.expiredDescription: Reset links work once, for 1 hour. Enter your email and we send you a new one.

failure.title: Orchester Cloud is not answering
failure.description: This page could not be loaded. Try again in a minute.
failure.missingDescription: Check the address, or start from the sign-in page.

getStarted.title: Get started
getStarted.signedIn: Orchester is signed in on {{count}} of your computers
getStarted.getText: Orchester runs on your computer. Sign in there with this account to join your team's servers.
getStarted.step2Text: Invites show here and in Orchester.
getStarted.step3Text: Settings › Orchester › Connect a server, with its setup code.

invites.title: Invites
invites.description: Projects and servers you were invited to. Accepting opens Orchester, which connects to the server and shows the project's join review.
invites.fromProject: {{inviter}} invited you to a project on {{server}}.
invites.fromServer: {{inviter}} invited you to the server, with no project yet.
invites.emptyText: When someone invites {{email}} to a project or a server, it shows here and in Orchester.
invites.failedText: Orchester Cloud did not answer. Reload the page to try again.

servers.title: Your servers
servers.description: Team servers you own or joined.
servers.projects: Projects and your role: in Orchester
servers.note: Orchester Cloud knows which servers you own or joined, not your projects or roles on them. Orchester asks each server for those.
servers.emptyText: Servers you join through an invite, and servers you connect in Orchester, are listed here.
servers.failedText: Orchester Cloud did not answer. Reload the page to try again.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Computers and browsers signed in to your account. Signing one out does not touch its connections to team servers.
devices.signedOutText: Its projects on team servers keep working. It asks for your password the next time it needs your account.

settings.title: Account
settings.displayNameHint: Shown on your invites and to teammates on team servers.
settings.emailHint: Changing your email is not available yet.
settings.passwordHint: Changing it signs out your other devices.
settings.newPasswordRule: New password: 12 to 256 characters. A long phrase is fine; there are no rules about symbols.
settings.passwordNote: Your other devices are signed out when it changes. Their projects on team servers keep working.
settings.currentWrong: The current password is not right.
settings.passwordChanged: Your password is changed. Your other devices are signed out; their projects on team servers keep working.
settings.signOutHint: Orchester on your computers stays signed in.
settings.deleteHint: Deletes your account from Orchester Cloud. Your accounts on team servers stay.
settings.deleteText: Your account, its devices and the invites to {{email}} are deleted at once, and every computer and browser is signed out of it. Your accounts on team servers and their projects keep working.
settings.deletePasswordHint: Your account's password, to confirm it is you.

authorize.adminDescription: {{server}}'s admin page asked Orchester Cloud who you are. Confirming sends it your account and name for this one sign-in; it gets no password.
authorize.linkDescription: You're setting up this server. Linked, it takes invites by email and lets people join with their Orchester account. Orchester Cloud records it as yours; it never sees its projects.
authorize.checkCodeSame: The same as on the server's console and its setup page.
authorize.invalid: The link that brought you here is incomplete or changed. Go back to the server's admin page and start again.
authorize.outOfDate: This page is out of date, open the link again.
authorize.notLinked: This team server isn't linked to Orchester Cloud. Its admins can link it in its Settings, or sign in there with a code.
authorize.wrongReturn: The page that sent you here isn't this team server's own admin, so Orchester Cloud doesn't answer it.
authorize.linkedElsewhere: This server is already linked to another Orchester account. Its owner can unlink it first.
authorize.statementRefused: The server's link didn't check out, or is more than 10 minutes old. Go back to its setup page and start again.
authorize.keysUnavailable: Orchester Cloud can't sign right now. Try again in a few minutes.
authorize.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again, then confirm.
authorize.tooMany: Too many requests. Try again in {{minutes}} min, at {{time}}.

deliver.sentText: Orchester Cloud has the invite. It reaches the person in Orchester if they have an account, and by email either way.
deliver.refusedTitle: Orchester Cloud didn't take this invite
deliver.refusedText: It wasn't signed by a server linked to Orchester Cloud, it expired, or it was sent too often. Make a new invite in the server's admin, or invite with a code.
deliver.unavailableText: The invite wasn't delivered. Try again in a few minutes, or invite with a code.
